classes.summary: AppConsents is a Windows UI automation page class that extends HPXRebrandingFlow and provides comprehensive test automation methods for HP application consent and privacy screens. The class contains 70+ methods divided into verification flows (for validating UI elements) and action flows (for interacting with UI elements). It supports multiple regions including China and India with region-specific consent handling. Key functionalities include: verifying and interacting with privacy consent screens, managing data collection preferences (product improvement and advertising toggles), handling terms of use and privacy statements, supporting app-only and app-device consent flows, extracting and validating consent text content, and managing app settings and reset operations. The class uses a driver object to perform UI automation operations with configurable timeouts and includes extensive logging for debugging purposes.
